S-MYGRACE.NAME: MyGrace
S-MYGRACE.core-purpose: Scalable GRACE methodology using lightweight indexes, per-module files, per-phase files, per-verification files, CLI lint/navigation, MCP tools, templates, and 14 skills.

key-surfaces.surface-1: skills/mygrace/grace-* contain the 14 canonical MyGRACE skill bodies.
key-surfaces.surface-2: templates/* provide index, module, phase, verification, AGENTS, QWEN, requirements, technology, and packet templates.
key-surfaces.surface-3: src/grace.ts is the CLI entry point.
key-surfaces.surface-4: src/grace-module.ts provides index-first module, phase, and verification navigation.
key-surfaces.surface-5: src/grace-lint.ts checks index sync, per-entity drift, semantic markup, XML tag conventions, and verification refs.
key-surfaces.surface-6: src/grace-mcp.ts exposes MyGRACE navigation and lint tools over MCP.

strengths.strength-1: Directly supplies the MAGRACE governance model and all requested skills.
strengths.strength-2: Index-first architecture aligns with Reasonix cache discipline and skill lazy-loading.
strengths.strength-3: CLI and MCP boundaries are small enough to port or wrap.

integration-obligations.obligation-1: Expose all 14 skills in MAGRA web chat through `/mygrace:*` slash commands.
integration-obligations.obligation-2: Port CLI internals to Node-compatible TypeScript or wrap Bun as optional, so Reasonix runtime does not require Bun on the critical path.
integration-obligations.obligation-3: Use MyGRACE templates but correct classic-template references to monolithic GRACE files when generating MAGRA artifacts.
integration-obligations.obligation-4: Keep the CLI/MCP lazy navigation behavior intact.

risks.risk-1: Upstream MyGRACE CLI currently uses simple XML regex parsing; MAGRACE should harden this before broad writes.
risks.risk-2: The MCP reference has a phase command mapping that should be reviewed before reuse.
risks.risk-3: Skill naming differs by platform; Reasonix needs a namespace adapter for slash names.
